name: CLIENT DISPLAY NAME
source_of_truth: e.g. official brand guide v2 / website URL / logo files supplied on DATE

fonts.heading: Font name (file in brand/fonts/ if not a Google font)
fonts.caption: Font name used for burned-in captions
fonts.licence_note: font licence / where it came from

logo.clear_space: e.g. height of the mark on all sides
never: place on busy backgrounds without a plate

motif: A brand shape that can be reused as a bullet, watermark or loader (e.g. the client's logo ring).

motion.easing: slow expo-out reveals, line draws, no bounce
motion.sound: soft swishes and chimes / punchy / none

style_recipes: names of styles/ recipes this client has approved
notes: anything the client said about look and feel
